items.title: Five connected workspaces
items.scope: Calculator, Equation Editor, Symbolic Solver, 2D/3D Graphs, Data Tables; the last tab is injected by the Data Tables module.
items.section: A. Workspace, equation editor and mathematical notation

items.title: Shared Working Equation hub
items.scope: Capture an input and route expressions/results among workspaces and notebook. Not every symbolic result is executable in every destination.
items.section: A. Workspace, equation editor and mathematical notation

items.title: Live text-to-math preview
items.scope: Browser MathML rendering of supported parsed notation.
items.section: A. Workspace, equation editor and mathematical notation

items.title: Text mathematical parser / AST
items.scope: Arithmetic, function calls, implicit multiplication, operators and many math layouts; **not** all LaTeX, arbitrary symbolic functions, or a proof assistant.
items.section: A. Workspace, equation editor and mathematical notation

items.title: Arithmetic and grouping notation
items.scope: `+ - * / ^`, parentheses, unary operators, fractions, negative/fractional powers.
items.section: A. Workspace, equation editor and mathematical notation

items.title: Equality and comparison notation
items.scope: `=`, `==`, `<`, `>`, `<=`, `>=`, `!=`; display support broader than numerical solving of inequalities.
items.section: A. Workspace, equation editor and mathematical notation

items.title: Superscripts and subscripts
items.scope: `x^2`, `x_1`, indexed notation.
items.section: A. Workspace, equation editor and mathematical notation

items.title: Roots, fractions and factorial notation
items.scope: `sqrt`, `root`, `frac`, `!`; evaluation depends on chosen workspace.
items.section: A. Workspace, equation editor and mathematical notation

items.title: Greek letters and mathematical constants
items.scope: Searchable library plus pi, e, imaginary unit, infinity notation.
items.section: A. Workspace, equation editor and mathematical notation

items.title: Vectors, accents, sets, logic notation
items.scope: `vec`, hats, overlines, set operators, logical glyphs, etc.; substantial portion is **typesetting only**.
items.section: A. Workspace, equation editor and mathematical notation

items.title: Matrix/array/determinant notation
items.scope: `matrix`, `pmatrix`, `array`, `vector`, `det` formatting; not a general matrix numeric/symbolic algebra UI.
items.section: A. Workspace, equation editor and mathematical notation

items.title: Calculus notation
items.scope: Derivatives, partial derivatives, integrals, limits, sums and products may be typeset; computational availability differs by method.
items.section: A. Workspace, equation editor and mathematical notation

items.title: Piecewise/conditional notation
items.scope: `if(condition,a,b)` works for native scalar numeric evaluation; `cases` displays piecewise forms. Not a general inequality/region solver.
items.section: A. Workspace, equation editor and mathematical notation

items.title: Transform notation
items.scope: Laplace, inverse Laplace, Fourier and inverse Fourier render in editor. Computational support separately below.
items.section: A. Workspace, equation editor and mathematical notation

items.title: Differential-equation notation
items.scope: Examples such as `diff(y(t),t)` and `pdiff(u(x,t),t)` in the editor.
items.section: A. Workspace, equation editor and mathematical notation

items.title: Searchable Symbols menu
items.scope: Nested category/subcategory symbols; insertion targets Editor or Calculator depending on active tool.
items.section: A. Workspace, equation editor and mathematical notation

items.title: Searchable equation examples / reference catalog
items.scope: General math examples and 72 additional reference physics/engineering equations in six categories. Examples are **not** physical-unit-checked simulations.
items.section: A. Workspace, equation editor and mathematical notation

items.title: Notebook with saved equations
items.scope: Add, edit, delete, reopen saved formula/text entries; browser local persistence.
items.section: A. Workspace, equation editor and mathematical notation

items.title: MathML/LaTeX output generation
items.scope: Good for supported AST, but not full macro compatibility/round-trip across math systems.
items.section: A. Workspace, equation editor and mathematical notation

items.title: Generated Python/SymPy notation
items.scope: Useful generated code for supported expressions/solver operations; not universal correct translation of arbitrary input.
items.section: A. Workspace, equation editor and mathematical notation

items.title: Contextual Help, Examples, Options menus
items.scope: Collapsible/floating UI with workspace guidance and display controls.
items.section: A. Workspace, equation editor and mathematical notation

items.title: Keyboard and responsive interaction
items.scope: Editor Enter/Shift+Enter, solver Ctrl+Enter, menus and shortcuts; comprehensive mobile/assistive-tech coverage remains unverified.

items.title: Real scalar arithmetic
items.scope: Finite double-precision JavaScript numeric evaluation.
items.section: B. Scientific calculator and numerical math

items.title: Hyperbolic functions

items.section: B. Scientific calculator and numerical math

items.title: Logarithms/exponentials

items.section: B. Scientific calculator and numerical math

items.title: Absolute value, norm, sign
items.scope: Scalar modulus/norm/sign; not matrix/vector norm analysis.
items.section: B. Scientific calculator and numerical math

items.title: Other scalar utilities
items.scope: `min`, `max`, `floor`, `ceil`, `round`, `mod`, `sinc`.
items.section: B. Scientific calculator and numerical math

items.title: Boolean/comparison and conditional numeric expressions
items.scope: Comparisons, logical conjunction/disjunction, three-argument `if`/`piecewise`; limited boolean language.
items.section: B. Scientific calculator and numerical math

items.title: Constants
items.scope: `pi`, `e`, `i`, stored `Ans`; other notation constants vary by evaluator.
items.section: B. Scientific calculator and numerical math

items.title: Radian/degree selector
items.scope: Calculator trig calculation mode; graph angles remain radians.
items.section: B. Scientific calculator and numerical math

items.title: Numeric display modes
items.scope: Auto, fixed/decimal, scientific and engineering notation; configurable displayed digits. Not arbitrary-precision arithmetic.
items.section: B. Scientific calculator and numerical math

items.title: Calculator keypad and history
items.scope: Scientific keypad, 40 recent results, recall, clear, persistent browser history.
items.section: B. Scientific calculator and numerical math

items.title: User-defined scalar variables
items.scope: Assign numeric scalars in calculator advanced panel; not a full variable/workspace/kernel language.
items.section: B. Scientific calculator and numerical math

items.title: Numerical first/partial derivatives
items.scope: Central finite differences, e.g. `diff(sin(x),x,0)`; no automatic differentiation or error estimators.
items.section: B. Scientific calculator and numerical math

items.title: Definite integration
items.scope: Composite Simpson quadrature (fixed number of steps, e.g. `int(x^2,x,0,3)`); no general adaptive/multidimensional integration UI.
items.section: B. Scientific calculator and numerical math

items.title: Finite sums
items.scope: `sum(...,start,end)`, limited to up to 10,000 terms; not symbolic infinite summation.
items.section: B. Scientific calculator and numerical math

items.title: Finite products
items.scope: `prod(...,start,end)`, same bounded integer range; not symbolic infinite products.
items.section: B. Scientific calculator and numerical math

items.title: DEC/BIN/HEX input and conversion
items.scope: Binary/hex literals and output chips; exact large *single-literal* conversion via BigInt, general safe-integer arithmetic limited near 53 bits.
items.section: B. Scientific calculator and numerical math

items.title: Bitwise integer functions
items.scope: `band`, `bor`, `bxor`, `bnot`, `shl`, `shr`, with safe-integer and shift constraints.
items.section: B. Scientific calculator and numerical math

items.title: Calculator-to-editor/solver routing
items.scope: Send expression/result to another workspace; unsuitable symbolic types may require selection/conversion.
items.section: B. Scientific calculator and numerical math

items.title: Full multistatement Python as Calculator language
items.scope: Available **only through saved, directly called Python custom functions**, not by pasting arbitrary Python statements into main Calculator input.
items.section: B. Scientific calculator and numerical math

items.title: Operation and engine selectors
items.scope: Auto, offline, SymPy; user chooses variable; worker-backed CAS starts on demand.
items.section: C. Symbolic algebra, equations and transforms

items.title: Polynomial expansion
items.scope: Offline one-variable polynomial/rational cases and SymPy fallback; not arbitrary tensor/assumption-aware algebra.
items.section: C. Symbolic algebra, equations and transforms

items.title: Rational simplification
items.scope: Cancel/simplify rational expressions; exclusions from original denominators need care.
items.section: C. Symbolic algebra, equations and transforms

items.title: Polynomial factorization
items.scope: Built-in rational-polynomial scope; advanced cases depend on SymPy.
items.section: C. Symbolic algebra, equations and transforms

items.title: Solving a single algebraic equation
items.scope: Polynomial/rational and supported SymPy equation classes; no universal closed-form solver.
items.section: C. Symbolic algebra, equations and transforms

items.title: Linear and quadratic equations
items.scope: Standard supported one-variable cases, real or complex.
items.section: C. Symbolic algebra, equations and transforms

items.title: Higher-degree polynomial equations
items.scope: SymPy may yield exact radicals for low-degree cases, or `RootOf`/numerical roots for high-degree cases.
items.section: C. Symbolic algebra, equations and transforms

items.title: Complex roots
items.scope: Supported polynomial equations and principal-branch arithmetic; verify multiplicity/domain as needed.
items.section: C. Symbolic algebra, equations and transforms

items.title: Trigonometric/transcendental equations
items.scope: SymPy attempts these and may return solution sets/conditions instead of enumerated finite roots.
items.section: C. Symbolic algebra, equations and transforms

items.title: Exact symbolic vs approximate roots
items.scope: Distinct symbolic and numeric answer forms; not high-precision general numerical workbench.
items.section: C. Symbolic algebra, equations and transforms

items.title: Symbolic differentiation
items.scope: Selected-variable derivatives via built-in polynomial support or SymPy for recognized expressions.
items.section: C. Symbolic algebra, equations and transforms

items.title: Symbolic indefinite integration
items.scope: Offline polynomial integration and SymPy for supported integrands; not all antiderivatives have closed forms.
items.section: C. Symbolic algebra, equations and transforms

items.title: SymPy numerical polynomial roots
items.scope: `nroots`/supported methods, fixed settings and result limits.
items.section: C. Symbolic algebra, equations and transforms

items.title: Solve a linear system of equations in UI
items.scope: New **Solve system of equations** operation, one equation per line, comma-separated unknowns; uses SymPy `linsolve`, up to 12 equations / 10 unknown names. Shows free parameters or inconsistency. **Not** a general nonlinear symbolic system solver.
items.section: C. Symbolic algebra, equations and transforms

items.title: Underdetermined symbolic linear systems
items.scope: Returns parameterized families (e.g. `x=-2z, y=-3z`) via `linsolve`; no dedicated matrix-rank or solution-space inspection panel.
items.section: C. Symbolic algebra, equations and transforms

items.title: Inconsistent linear systems
items.scope: A “no solution” result for inconsistent `linsolve` systems.
items.section: C. Symbolic algebra, equations and transforms

items.title: Forward/inverse Laplace transforms
items.scope: SymPy transform operations with specified input/output variables; convergence/assumptions require interpretation.
items.section: C. Symbolic algebra, equations and transforms

items.title: Forward/inverse Fourier transforms
items.scope: SymPy Fourier convention `exp(-2*pi*i*k*x)`; not a numeric FFT/signal processing toolbox.
items.section: C. Symbolic algebra, equations and transforms

items.title: Analytical ODE solving
items.scope: `sympy.dsolve` for recognized classes, including basic first-order/higher-order examples. No user-defined initial/boundary conditions UI.
items.section: C. Symbolic algebra, equations and transforms

items.title: Analytical PDE solving
items.scope: `sympy.pdsolve` for supported classes (e.g. first-order transport); far from general PDE solving.
items.section: C. Symbolic algebra, equations and transforms

items.title: CAS result typesetting
items.scope: MathML, LaTeX and approximate text where present; individual result lines.
items.section: C. Symbolic algebra, equations and transforms

items.title: Send/copy/save specific symbolic results
items.scope: Notebook, Word, Latex, other workspaces; some CAS objects cannot be numerically re-evaluated in Calculator.
items.section: C. Symbolic algebra, equations and transforms

items.title: Equivalent SymPy code display
items.scope: Generates code for many operations; system solver's code panel currently contains a *placeholder comment*, not a fully executable equivalent.
items.section: C. Symbolic algebra, equations and transforms

items.title: Worker isolation and operation guardrails
items.scope: Structured AST to SymPy, limits (e.g. AST nodes/result counts/timeouts); first Pyodide download requires internet and web workers are not a blanket security guarantee.
items.section: C. Symbolic algebra, equations and transforms

items.title: Bounded real roots of nonlinear scalar equations
items.scope: Bracket/bisection plus sampled local Newton search; may miss tangential/oscillatory roots, discontinuities or outside-range roots.
items.section: D. Numerical equation solving and numerical PDEs

items.title: Initial interval and tolerance controls
items.scope: Numeric domain, sampling and tolerance validation.
items.section: D. Numerical equation solving and numerical PDEs

items.title: Numerical nonlinear systems (2–3 variables)
items.scope: Damped Newton with numerical Jacobian, user initial guesses; local convergence, not exhaustive/certified.
items.section: D. Numerical equation solving and numerical PDEs

items.title: Residual/iteration diagnostics
items.scope: Reports convergence, iterations and residual within supported numeric methods.
items.section: D. Numerical equation solving and numerical PDEs

items.title: 1D Poisson boundary-value solver
items.scope: Finite differences for `-u''=f(x)` on interval with Dirichlet values at both ends; tridiagonal solver; not arbitrary PDE/geometry.

items.title: 1D heat initial-boundary-value solver
items.scope: Explicit FTCS for `u_t=alpha*u_xx`, positive constant alpha, fixed Dirichlet ends, and CFL check.
items.section: D. Numerical equation solving and numerical PDEs

items.title: Discretization and stability validation
items.scope: Controls for grid/time-step counts; heat CFL warning, no adaptive discretization/error certification.
items.section: D. Numerical equation solving and numerical PDEs

items.title: Numerical results as Data Tables
items.scope: Generate tables with root/system or sampled Poisson/heat output as applicable.
items.section: D. Numerical equation solving and numerical PDEs

items.scope: Route generated tables to 2D/3D plotting workflows.
items.section: D. Numerical equation solving and numerical PDEs
